title: Singing
summary: SING'ING, participle present tense Uttering melodious or musical notes; making a shrill sound; celebrating in song; reciting in verse. SING'ING, noun The act of uttering sounds with musical inflection

inlines.v: SING'ING, participle present tense Uttering melodious or musical notes; making a shrill sound; celebrating in song; reciting in verse. SING'ING, noun The act of uttering sounds with musical inflections; musical articulation; the utterance of melodious notes.
